subject: MSA + Order Form: signer authority & envelope handoff
summary: Coordination to confirm signing authority, DocuSign routing order, notarization requirement and final clean-copy handoff for MSA + Order Form.
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bespokehealth.com>, contracts@bespokehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form: signer authority & next steps

Alex / Contracts team — attaching our redlines and a clean Order Form PDF. We think the outstanding items are limited to one narrow legal point (Section 7.2 liability carveouts) and final signer authority. To get to signature quickly I propose: 

- You confirm who at Bespoke Health will execute the MSA and Order Form (full name + title).
- If a POA or notary/witness is required, let us know now so we can configure the envelope.
- We can prepare a DocuSign envelope and route sign order: customer signers first, then Redwood execs. If you prefer your counsel to sign last, flag it.

Attachments: Bespoke_MSA_redlines_20270408.docx (redline), OrderForm_Bespoke_Clean_20270408.pdf (clean)

Goal: have envelope ready by EOD Friday and sign by early next week.

Thanks —
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
nkhil_sharma@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0173

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bespokehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@bespokehealth.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: signer authority & next steps

Thanks, Nikhil — received and reviewed the redlines. Counsel has a handful of language tweaks but nothing that should block execution. A couple items on our side: 

- The authorized signatory will be: Dana Morales, Chief Legal & Compliance Officer (Dana.Morales@bespokehealth.com).
- Bespoke requires a notarized signature for agreements above our threshold; our legal team can either: (a) provide a POA naming Dana as authorized signer, or (b) request notarization and a witness on the final packet. Which would you prefer?
- Counsel (I copied contracts@bespokehealth.com) asked whether Redwood is able to include a clause to retain the prior data processing addendum — they’ll send exact language by EOD.

If you can draft the envelope with both options (POA upload or notarization checkbox) that would speed things. Otherwise we can confirm tomorrow morning.

Onward —
Alex
Business Ops Lead, Bespoke Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: signer authority & next steps

Looping in to set up the envelope. Implementation notes for DocuSign routing: 

1) Sign order I suggest: Bespoke signers (Dana Morales) -> Bespoke counsel (contracts@bespokehealth.com, if they want to sign) -> Redwood legal (Marissa Cole) -> Redwood exec (Ben Carter).
2) DocuSign supports a document upload for POA; if they supply a POA we will include as required attachment and set a recipient role to "Verifier".
3) If notarization required: we can set a sign field for a notary/witness line and include an instruction page asking Bespoke to arrange notarization. Notarized docs add an extra step but are straight-forward.
4) Clean-copy handoff: after final signatures, we will produce a single consolidated PDF and send clean copies to both teams and upload to the deal in HubSpot.

Action items for us: I will prepare the envelope draft today and add conditional fields for POA vs notarization. Ben — can you confirm the Redwood exec signer availability next week (earliest midday Mon)?

-Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bespokehealth.com>, contracts@bespokehealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: signer authority & next steps

Alex — thanks for confirming Dana. Two quick clarifications before we draft the envelope: 

1) Please confirm whether Bespoke will: a) provide a scanned POA naming Dana, or b) require notarization. If you choose POA we’ll include an "Upload POA" signer step that blocks finalization until uploaded.
2) If notarization, please confirm whether a witness signature is required in addition to the notary seal (some states require both).

If you’re good with option (a) POA, we’ll create the envelope now and send it to Dana for signature. If option (b), we’ll create the envelope with a help page and mark final execution as "conditional" pending notarized PDF return.

We aim to send the envelope by 10:30 PDT today if we get your confirmation.

Best,
Nikhil

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@bespokehealth.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@bespokehealth.com
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: signer authority & next steps

Nikhil / Marissa — thanks. We will provide a scanned POA naming Dana Morales (option a). Counsel confirmed no witness required, notarization not necessary if POA is uploaded. Counsel will send the POA file to contracts@bespokehealth.com and copy you.

Please proceed with the DocuSign envelope. Dana will be first signer; counsel copied above will get a sign-off placeholder in case they prefer to countersign (they likely will not). Let us know once the envelope is live and when Redwood signers are scheduled so Dana’s calendar can be reserved.

Alex
Business Ops Lead, Bespoke Health
(Quoted inline replies appear above where applicable.)
